title: Frequently Asked Questions
snippet:
The Podio API is available to use for both paid and free Podio accounts. Both have full access to the API and the same base rate Limit A and Limit B apply. There is no extra charge for using the API as long as the usage is within these base rate limits. Paid accounts have an additional capability of upgrading to higher API rate limits by purchasing an API Add-on.

If your API integration requires a higher rate limit, you can request your contract owner to purchase an API Add-on for the relevant API key. The API Add-on increases both Limit A and Limit B, with multiple tiers available to suit different usage requirements. See the [product documentation](https://progress.com/podio/documentation/using-podio/upgrade-and-billing/what-add-ons-in-podio)

title: Podio Troubleshooting & FAQs Podio Hybrid Pricing FAQ - Progress Podio
snippet:
Are API base limits changing? No. Standard included API limits remain based on the existing two-limit model:
- **Limit A:** 250 API calls per hour for resource-intensive API calls.
- **Limit B:** 1,000 API calls per hour for all other API calls.
These limits are measured on a rolling-hour basis. Customers who need API capacity above the included limits can purchase an API Add-on once add-ons become available.

title: Podio upgrade-and-billing How Add-ons Increase Your API and Automation Limits - Progress Podio
snippet:
Every API key and Automation Account starts with a base limit included in your plan, at no additional cost:
- API keys include up to 250 API calls per hour for Limit A and up to 1,000 API calls per hour for Limit B.
- Automation Accounts on a Premium plan include up to 25,000 actions per month.

title: Podio Pricing 2026: Plans, Costs, Limits and Real Value
snippet:
- **External clients are free:** Contractors, freelancers and client users need no paid seat on any plan, provided your organisation has a company domain.

What you get | Key limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 per user per month | $0 per user per month | Task management, apps and workspaces, unlimited workspaces, unlimited apps, granular app permissions, automated workflows, webforms, read-only access | Five employees; 100 items per organisation shared across all apps and workspaces |
| Plus | $14.00 per user per month | $11.20 per user per month | Everything in Free, plus unlimited items, unlimited task management, unlimited 100 MB file additions, user management, unlimited client users, light user role, SOC2 compliance | API access is listed as 1,000 calls per hour on one official page and 1,000 calls per day on the other |
| Premium | $24.00 per user per month | $19.20 per user per month | Everything in Plus, plus visual reports, interactive sales dashboards, cloud phone system and power dialer, advanced workflow automation at 5M runs per month, email integrations, PDF generation, ShareFile and e-signature | Advanced workflow and API capacity is sold as prepaid add-ons under the hybrid model |

Plus costs $14.00 per user per month on monthly billing and $11.20 per user per month when billed annually. It removes the item cap and adds unlimited task management, unlimited 100 MB file additions, user management, unlimited client users, a light user role, read-only access, automated workflows and SOC2 compliance.
API access is included, though the two official pages disagree on the ceiling. One lists 1,000 calls per hour and the other 1,000 calls per day, so verify the limit inside your own account before you build heavy integrations on top of it.
### Premium: automation, dashboards and telephony
Premium costs $24.00 per user per month monthly or $19.20 per user per month annually. On top of Plus it adds visual reports, interactive sales dashboards, a cloud phone system with power dialer, advanced workflow automation listed at 5M runs per month, email integrations, PDF generation, date-and-time workflow triggers, ShareFile and e-signature integration, and upgradable API limits.
Annual Premium organisations also receive partner offers, including a 50% discount for three months with Plecto for up to ten sales agents and $100 of free credit with smrtPhone. Those extras are worth checking if your team already uses sales dashboards or dialers.
